curated: He wants to give her the whole sky but has only his love to offer. A sweet, heartfelt pick for saying sorry, or for a birthday or anniversary.
he'd give her the sky; heartfelt for making up or a special day
He sings to a woman who is ignoring him, praising her and asking her to soften. Use it when she isn't talking to you or is sulking after you let her down.
a gentle plea to the girl who's ignoring him
A high-energy folk dance number for parties and baraats.
A breezy, happy song about being totally charmed by her. Send it to lift her mood once the fight is cooling down.
light and happy, it shows you're crazy about her
Love at first sight, told with breezy charm. For a new crush or reminding her how you first fell for her.
love at first sight, breezy and fun
A dreamy, spellbound love song. For telling her you can't stop thinking about her.
A plea asking love to forgive him. Emotional apology territory.
A playful, confident song from the girl's side about her man. Fun for couples.
a playful, confident love song from her side
The classic making-up song: he has upset her and tells her that her smile is all he wants. Works for any small fight, missed plans or a forgotten promise. Sweet, not heavy.
the go-to song to win back an upset girlfriend: all he wants is her smile
A warm welcome for the bride into the family. For weddings and for telling your wife she lights up the home.
a joyful welcome for the bride
Her inner thoughts as she realises she is falling for him. Good for a new crush.
the feeling of falling for someone
A massy, chaotic dance number. For parties and processions.
A tender tribute to a mother's sacrificing love.
a tender tribute to a mother's love
A heartfelt song telling her she is everything. For saying how much she means after a rough patch.
tells her she's everything to him
A straight-up 'I am sorry' song to a girlfriend. Use it when you clearly messed up and want to say sorry directly.
Love between a soldier and his partner, kept alive across distance. For long-distance couples.
A soft, sweet romantic song about love that feels destined. For an anniversary or a sweet message.
a soft song about love that feels destined
A gentle song about the heart's confusion in love. For when you are unsure and want to talk it out.
a gentle song about a confused heart
The title literally asks her to forgive him. An emotional apology for when you've hurt her feelings.
the title literally means 'forgive me, dear'
Longing and questions after a love that slipped away. For a breakup or a love that is far away.
longing for a love that slipped away
A classic wedding blessing song. For weddings and anniversaries.
An anthem about an unlikely, deep friendship. Dedicate it to your best friend.
an anthem for an unbreakable friendship
An explosive dance celebration of two friends. For parties, sangeet or celebrating with your gang.
A rough hero admits he can't stop thinking about her, even though she won't look at him. Fits when she is ignoring you.
he's hopelessly drawn to her even when she won't look at him
A rustic, affectionate song in which she calls her man lovingly. A fun pick for couples.
A rustic, playful compliment on how lovely she looks. Good for making her smile.
a rustic, playful compliment that makes her smile
A playful, dramatic plea begging her for a little mercy and love. Good when the fight is small and a bit of humour will melt her, like a missed movie or being late.
a playful, over-the-top plea for her mercy, great when the fight is small
A love-letter-like duet between lovers who are apart. Fits long-distance couples.
a love-letter duet for couples who are apart
Pure wonder at how beautiful she is, from a film about love kept alive through letters. Lovely for long distance or an anniversary.
pure admiration from a love-letter film, lovely for long distance
Lovers dreaming of their wedding. For engagements, wedding videos or telling her you see a future together.
An old classic in which he asks his beloved why she is angry and coaxes her out of her sulk. A charming retro pick.
a classic that asks 'are you angry, dear?' and coaxes her out of it
A wistful song about a heart that won't listen. For missing someone or love you can't control.
about a heart that just won't listen
He tries to coax his upset girlfriend into talking again, calling her by a pet name and promising to make it up to her. Great for long distance or when work kept you away.
he coaxes his upset girl with a pet name, perfect when you've been away or busy
A soft, dreamy love song. For a sweet message or a new relationship.
A soulful ode to her eyes and a seaside first love. For a proposal or an anniversary.
a soulful ode to her eyes
A salute to women and their strength. For Women's Day, or to thank your mother, sister or partner.
a salute to women and their strength
A heartbroken lover begs the one leaving to stay. Use it when things are serious and you don't want to lose them.
a heartfelt 'please stay' when things are serious
An intense, aching love song. For when you badly miss her.
Breathless pain of being separated from the one you love.
The wonder of first love. For a new crush or remembering how it started.
